text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe should further improve its investment climate to attract more foreign capital, British High Commissioner to Zimbabwe Martin Williams said on Monday.
- A high-level political and business leadership led by Zimbabwe President Robert Mugabe has gathered in London to attend a crucial investment conference on Wednesday.
- The municipal council in Zimbabwe's second city of Bulawayo is considering developing a $1.6 million wellfield to improve its water supply.
